headline:
The 30-Year Rate
Held Steady In Mid-October
titan_line: Echo, Freddie Mac says the 30-year fixed rate averaged 7.40% as of October 15, the same as the week before. A year ago it was 6.27%. The 15-year averaged 6.71%.
checks_rows: A national average from loan applications, not a quote
echo_line: Unchanged? …Oh, same as the week before. Higher than a year ago, though. I'd still ask a lender for my own number.
source: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey · week of Oct 15, 2026 · retrieved Oct 17, 2026
disclaimer: National weekly averages for the week stated. Not a rate quote or a prediction. Your own rate depends on your lender and your credit.
